sources.title: Services: Tourist Visa
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Plurinational State of Bolivia
sources.officialityEvidence: Live central Foreign Ministry service page, directly replayed over valid TLS. It defines tourism Group I, II and III and describes a visa as a travel document issued by Bolivian consulates and embassies, but supplies no nationality schedule for these residual passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La visa es un documento de viaje emitido por los Consulados y Embajadas de Bolivia en el exterior.

sources.title: Visa Application System
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Plurinational State of Bolivia
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry portal is linked by the central service page as Solicitud de visas. Its public replay exposes no direct nationality eligibility, group assignment, or electronically delivered ordinary-visitor visa result for any scoped passport.
